brief: Apply the loading restriction in MG-021 to Penrose Park 230/34kV ahead of the heat event, as active seepage at the lower gasket face cannot be attended before the event [MG-023]. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value and the period [MG-021]. Restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified, not when the event ends [MG-021].
